title: P1 fail: request
description: The holder reports the end of work without an outcome: a reason code from reasons.yaml, retryable and retry_after_s. There is no free text reason; whether the reason spends an attempt is decided by the reason registry (FEN-3). The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).
